notes: Ask Fenrir: type what you want into the command palette (Ctrl+K). Fenrir does the everyday things itself and nothing changes until you press Do it; AI apps such as Claude Code can use Fenrir too, each change with your Yes in Fenrir's own window.
Game servers look after themselves: back after a crash or a restart, a daily restart, backups while their world changes, a stop when nobody is on, and how hard they work.
When a modded game crashes, its page names the mod most likely to blame; mod sets and Thunderstore updates keep the mods that work together.
Settings shows everything Fenrir changed on this PC, each with its way back.
